verdict.rationale: Factory docs mention connecting Slack (and other chat/collaboration tools) to keep development synchronized, which implies some chat-based interaction, but there is no explicit documentation of tagging/mentioning a droid within a Slack thread to discuss or delegate a specific bug/task. Missing for 10: explicit Slack @-mention/thread-based delegation workflow, confirmation that a droid can be invoked and hold a conversation directly inside a chat thread, and any independent corroboration of this UX.
